answer.says: Ramesh, the household requires its proper rhythm. The body must be sustained so that the spirit may attend to its duties. See that the breakfast is served promptly, for the day’s work begins with the satisfaction of the natural need.
answer.thought: The grey sky continues its suspension, offering no immediate brightness to the spirit. I must attend to the natural need of the body, for the ethical life begins with the satisfaction of the particular before it can ascend to the universal. Ramesh is the medium through which the house maintains its order; I must address him with the courtesy due to a servant, but with the authority due to the master.
